verdicts.human_summary: DOM text (title attribute) is reinterpreted as HTML without escaping meta-characters, creating an XSS vulnerability
verdicts.reasoning: AI Comment 2 addresses the exact same concern at the same file (classDb.ts:510, just 2 lines away from the human's :512). Both identify that the title text is set as raw HTML via .html() without sanitization, creating a cross-site scripting vulnerability. The AI comment even recommends the fix (DOMPurify.sanitize).
